title: Installment a TRICARE Prime Draft on File Is Drawn Toward
content:
**Desk guidance.** For a draft through the payment method a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment keeps on file, the installment the region's draft is toward is read from the installment charges on the account:

1. Where the installment posted most recently covers a month before the current month, the region's draft is toward that **back-billed installment**.
2. Where no such installment was posted most recently and the enrollment's payment arrangement is annual, it is toward the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest.
3. Otherwise it is toward the installment whose coverage period begins latest.

"Posted most recently" goes by posting date; "begins latest" goes by the first day of the coverage period.

## Cases (hypothetical, today in September)

| Charge posted most recently | Arrangement | Draft is toward |
|---|---|---|
| a charge posted on 5 September covering April to August | monthly | that back-billed charge |
| the September monthly charge, posted 1 September | monthly | the installment whose coverage begins latest - the September charge |
| a monthly charge covering September, posted 1 September, while an annual charge beginning 1 January is on the account | annual | the annual installment beginning latest - the 1 January charge |
